description: Template for bulk video upload metadata. Each entry must include a 'filename' that exists in the same directory as this file.

entries.title: Quadriceps Sets (Isometric Tightening)
entries.description: Sit with your leg straight and tighten the thigh muscle, pressing the back of the knee downward.

entries.title: Straight Leg Raises
entries.description: Lie on your back, bend one knee, and keep the other straight. Slowly lift the straight leg about 12 inches off the floor.

entries.title: Heel Slides
entries.description: Lie on your back or sit, and slowly slide your heel toward your buttocks to bend the knee, then slide it back out.
